major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Blades
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use when at least one Shadow Dance charge is available and Secret Technique is ready; hold slightly if needed to align all three cooldowns together at the start of each burst window.

major_cooldowns.name: Shadow Dance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use only when Secret Technique is ready (two charges with 60s recharge); during Shadow Blades delay the second charge until Shadow Blades has 8-10 seconds remaining so it lines up with Secret Technique coming back off cooldown.

major_cooldowns.name: Secret Technique
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast as the first finisher inside every Shadow Dance window at 6+ combo points; cooldown is dynamically reduced by haste, causing it to naturally align with Bloodlust.

major_cooldowns.name: Vanish
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown at 0-2 combo points to gain a Premeditation-boosted Shadowstrike; prioritize utility uses (interrupt, gap close, mechanic avoidance) over the minor damage gain when an opportunity arises.

defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Use to immune incoming magic debuffs or survive heavy magic damage phases; plan its use before predictable magic bursts rather than reacting after the damage lands.

defensives.name: Evasion
defensives.usage_rule: Use when taking heavy physical damage or tanking unavoidable melee hits; your strongest physical mitigation cooldown, best used proactively before a known physical burst.

defensives.name: Feint
defensives.usage_rule: Use proactively before predictable AoE daoldown means it can cover nearly every major AoE in a fight and is your most frequently available defensive.

defensives.name: Crimson Vial
defensives.usage_rule: Use to recover health between damage spikes; available frequently enough to use mid-combat rather than hoarding as a last resort.

rules.description: Shadow Dance must pair with Secret Technique
rules.action: Only activate Shadow Dance when Secret Technique is off cooldown — the Supercharger talent supercharges your finisher combo points during Dance, making Secret Technique deal massively more damage insi.

rules.description: Hold Dance and SecTech for Shadow Blades
rules.action: When Shadow Blades is within 15 seconds of coming off cooldown, stop spending Shadow Dance charges and hold Secret Technique so all three cooldowns align together at the start of the next burst window

Enter combat from Stealth and open with Shadowstrike (consuming Premeditation for full combo points), then immediately activate Shadow Dance and Shadow Blades together, followed by Secret Technique as your first finisher at 6+ combo points.

rules.description: Enter Shadow Dance at max or zero combo points
rules.action: Activate Shadow Dance at either 6-7 combo poicret Technique) or 0-1 combo points (open with a Superchargedbuilder); never at mid-range because Premeditation gives full combo points on your first builder and wastes value at middle counts.

rules.description: Delay second Dance mid-Shadow Blades, not back-to-back
rules.action: During Shadow Blades, use your first Shadow Dance immediately but delay the second until Shadow Blades has roughly 8-10 seconds remaining, so the second Dance window overlaps with Secret Technique coming back off cooldown rather than burning both Dances consecutively.

rules.description: Stack trinkets and racials inside Shadow Blades
rules.action: Use on-use trinkets (Light Company Guidon, Emefore Shadow Dance and Shadow Blades, and pop racial cooldowns(Berserking, Blood Fury, Fireblood) when Shadow Blades is active to stack all damage multipliers together.

rules.description: Macro Shadow Dance with SecTech or Shuriken Storm
rules.action: Use a macro pairing Shadow Dance with Secret Technique (at max combo points) or Shuriken Storm (at low combo points) to eliminate input-delay GCD loss inside the short Dance window — a missed ful damage loss.

rules.description: Stay behind target for Backstab bonus damage
rules.action: Always position behind the target — Backstab deals significantly more damage from behind and bosses can only parry attacks from the front, causing you to lose meaningful damage on every parry.

source_summary: Subtlety Rogue in Midnight concentrates almost all damage into 90-second burst windows by stacking Shadow Blades, Shadow Dance, and Secret Technique together every rotation. Shadow Dance should et Technique ready, both cooldowns must be held when ShadowBlades is within 15 seconds of coming off cooldown, and the second Dance during Shadow Blades should be delayed to line up with Secret Technique's second use rather than spent back-to-back. All trinkets, potions, and into the Shadow Blades window to maximize multiplicative damage overlap.
